name: 92844 · Garden Grove, CA
findings: ZIP 92844 (Garden Grove) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (18%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92844 (Garden Grove) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92844 (Garden Grove) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
